transcript.content: Hello. I'm glad you're here today. What brings you in to see me?

I'm here because I've been having these episodes where I eat an unusually large amount of food in one sitting. It feels like I completely lose control during these times and just can't seem to stop eating.
After these episodes of overeating, do you ever do anything to try to prevent weight gain, such as making yourself throw up, using laxatives, fasting, or exercising excessively?
No, I don't do any of those things. I've never tried to make myself throw up, use laxatives, or force myself to exercise after an episode.
Have you recently experienced significant weight loss, or do you currently maintain a body weight that is much lower than what is considered healthy for your height?
No, I haven't experienced any significant weight loss recently. My weight is definitely not abnormally low or unhealthy in that way.
How often do these episodes of overeating typically occur, and how many months has this been going on?
This has been going on for about six months now. On average, these episodes happen at least once a week.

During these episodes of overeating, do you experience things like eating much faster than normal, eating until you feel uncomfortably full, or feeling very guilty or disgusted with yourself afterward?
Yes, I definitely eat much faster than normal during these episodes, almost like I'm rushing through it. I also find myself eating a lot even when I'm not actually feeling hungry at all.
How do you feel emotionally about these eating episodes? Do they cause you a lot of distress or make you feel very upset or guilty?
I'm not really sure, to be honest. I haven't thought much about how I feel emotionally during or after these episodes.
Do you often eat these large amounts of food alone because you feel embarrassed by how much you are eating?
I'm not really sure about that. I haven't really thought about whether I eat alone because of embarrassment or not.
When you have these episodes of overeating, do you often keep eating until you feel uncomfortably full?
I'm not entirely sure, to be honest. I haven't really paid attention to whether I reach the point of feeling uncomfortably full during those times.
After one of these episodes, do you ever feel disgusted with yourself, depressed, or very guilty?
I'm not really sure how to describe my feelings afterward. I haven't really thought about it that way, so I can't say for sure if I feel disgusted or guilty.
Do these episodes of overeating cause you significant distress or worry, or do they affect your daily life and relationships?
I'm not quite sure, to be honest. I haven't really thought about it in that way, so I don't know if it affects my daily life or relationships.
